svg.title: SIFT Sentinel architecture diagram
svg.desc: Shows how evidence flows through the MCP server, agent, evidence graph, validators, and correlation engine to produce a forensic report. Architectural and prompt-based guardrails are clearly distinguished.
svg.text: ARCHITECTURAL GUARDRAILS (enforced by code - cannot be bypassed)

g.text: OS-level mount -o ro,loop - SHA-256 manifest - post-exec verification
12 typed tools - no shell access - structured data parsing
System prompt - self-review - reasoning chains - safeguards
Forensic analysis report - every claim traceable
Architectural - enforced by code, cannot be bypassed by the LLM
Prompt-based - enforced by instructions, backed by architectural catch layers
